$comment: Vendored/adopted skill pools fed to OMP by omp/extensions/dotfiles-skills.ts (resources_discover skillPaths). Marketplace-installed pools do NOT belong here - Claude's installed_plugins.json is their source of truth and OMP ingests it natively. Fields: root = package root relative to the dotfiles dir (skills expected at <root>/skills); ompSkillsDir = a skills directory to use instead of <root>/skills; omp=false = skip the pool. installers/omp.sh clones the vendor/ checkouts.

sources.$comment: One agent-c skill, linked per-skill by installers/omp.sh into this farm; pointing at agent-c's whole skills directory would publish ~100 skills.
